description: NotFair connects ChatGPT to your own Google Ads, Meta Ads, Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4, and WordPress site, plus LinkedIn, Reddit, TikTok, and X Ads and GoHighLevel, through authorized provider APIs. Ask it to find wasted ad spend, research keywords, explain a traffic drop, fix indexing and on-page SEO, or build campaigns. It reads live account data, shows each change before it runs, and makes edits only after you approve them, with change tracking.

defaultPrompt: Find wasted spend in my Google Ads account over the last 30 days.
Why did my Google traffic drop? Check Search Console and Google Analytics.
Rewrite the SEO title and meta description for my WordPress homepage. Show me before publishing.
